//pnpm-overrides: TEMPORARY — @cendor/guardrails is not on npm yet. Points at a packed tarball of the sibling build (a plain `file:<dir>` can't resolve guardrails' `@cendor/core: workspace:^`; `pnpm pack` rewrites it to a concrete range). Rebuild the tarball with `pnpm --dir ../cendor-libs-js/packages/guardrails pack --pack-destination .`. The @cendor/core pin unifies the tarball's core with the SDK's so ONE core resolves (no split-brain — the SDK lockfile pinned 0.4.0 while the tarball wants ^0.4.1). DROP THIS ENTIRE `pnpm` block in the release-gate commit before pushing (published @cendor/guardrails@^0.1.0 then resolves from npm, and npm dedupes core normally). See PUBLISHING.md.
